page.layout: One table of Scripture references at left, with a vertical rule and page references at its right; at the right edge, the beginnings of a further column (C. XIX, C. XX, C. XX). Running head above the table. Ornament below the table (not text).; One column of Scripture references in two sub-columns: left, short verse labels (cut off at the left edge); right, chapter, verse and page references. Running head across the top. Catchword "INDEX" at the lower right. Engraved ornament at the left edge, below the list.
page.notes: Right-hand entries C. XIX and C. XX are only partly visible; their page references are not shown. Doubtful readings: the chapter number after "C. XIII." (marked [?]) overlaps a mark and may be 7 or 8; the running head's last letters are doubtful. Left edge of the scan is cut, so the first part of several verse labels is missing; only the visible letters are given. Reference numbers in the right column are copied as printed, including the separated pieces on continuation lines. Small dots and specks are scan noise and were left out.
